info.title: Dante Smart Remote Repairs API
info.description: REST API for the IT support, remote assistance, repair and e-commerce platform. All endpoints are under /api/v1. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Responses use `{ data, meta? }` on success and `{ error: { code, message, details? } }` on failure.
